title: Preface
catalogue_title: Preface to the Special Issue in Memoriam of Jacques Tits

content_dispositions.content: History of the journal and its relationship with Jacques Tits.
Memorial volume introduction and thanks to contributors.
Descriptions of the biography and two other contributions to the volume.
Reflection on the variety and motivation of the collected papers.
Editorial closing and thanks to the publisher.
